## Software & artifacts

**dopamine-PINN** (2026). JAX/Flax code, data and results for the dopamine
paper, MIT License.
[\[Zenodo\]](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23518612) ·
[\[GitHub\]](https://github.com/Hachero98/dopamine-PINN-)

**PINN-NS Research Workspace** (2026). Open-source dissertation workspace —
modular PINN solvers, classical numerical baselines, manufactured solutions, and
fully reproducible experiment configs for 3D Navier–Stokes.
[\[CITATION\]](#) · [\[GitHub\]](#)
